question: Which divine groups must be worshipped around the central seat?
premises: The lords of knowledge are to be worshipped around.
The world-guardians are also to be worshipped.
These acts follow the preceding worship.
inference: One should worship the lords of knowledge around and then worship the world-guardians.
plain_english: Having worshipped the lords of knowledge around, one should then worship the guardians of the worlds.
